cohort_and_stratum: 15 human sALS donor iPSC-MN lines
assay_and_contrast: 2.5 uM Retigabine vs paired DMSO survival (days)
notes: Exact 2-sided Wilcoxon p=0.1354 (q=0.3292); does not pass 107-drug BH-FDR.

cohort_and_stratum: Human ALS Phase 2 RCT (600 mg/d, 900 mg/d, placebo x 8 wk)
assay_and_contrast: Cortical TMS SICI inverse ratio & 8-wk ALSFRS-R/dropout
effect_estimate: 900 mg SICI ratio 1.53 (95% CI 1.12-2.09); permanent drug dropout 26.3-30.4% vs 0% placebo
notes: 600 mg SICI p=0.31; 8-wk ALSFRS-R non-significant; Kovalchuk 2018 PMID:29672831 (N=18) confirmed acute axonal PD.

cohort_and_stratum: Human POTIGA 300 mg TID steady-state vs human Kv7.2/7.3 EC50
assay_and_contrast: Unbound plasma PK (MW 303.34, fup~0.20) & commercial status
effect_estimate: Cu,plasma peak/avg/trough = 0.669/0.434/0.224 uM vs Kv7.2/7.3 EC50 0.35-2.5 uM; NDA022345 Discontinued
notes: Withdrawn globally (2017-2018) after quinone-dimer retinal pigmentary maculopathy & blue skin discoloration.

cohort_and_stratum: Next-gen non-pigmenting Kv7.2/7.3 openers (QRL-101, BHV-7000, XEN1101)
assay_and_contrast: Clinical trial registry audit in ALS & epilepsy
effect_estimate: QRL-101 completed 6 Phase 1 studies incl. ALS PK/PD SDTC trial NCT06714396 (N=12); BHV-7000/XEN1101 in Ph3
notes: Selective Kv7.2/7.3 openers without aniline/quinone-dimer liability supersede ezogabine as clinical matter.

cohort_and_stratum: 16 human sALS donor iPSC-MN lines
assay_and_contrast: 2.5 uM Ceftriaxone vs paired DMSO survival (days)
notes: Exact 2-sided Wilcoxon p=0.4212; null in human sALS motor neurons.

cohort_and_stratum: Human ALS Phase 3 Stage 3 RCT (2-4 g/d IV ceftriaxone vs placebo)
assay_and_contrast: Co-primary ALSFRS-R slope & tracheostomy-free survival; SAEs
effect_estimate: ALSFRS-R diff +0.09 u/mo (95% CI -0.06 to 0.24); survival HR=0.90 (0.71-1.15); biliary SAEs 12.1% vs 0%
notes: Stopped early by DSMB for futility (survival p=0.4146; 41/340 vs 0/173 hepatobiliary/cholelithiasis SAEs).

cohort_and_stratum: Stage 1/2 ALS patients on 2-4 g/d IV ceftriaxone (N=66)
assay_and_contrast: Measured human CSF ceftriaxone (MW 554.59) vs human EAAT2 EC50
effect_estimate: Human ALS CSF maintained ~2-6 uM (>1.0 uM prespecified target), whereas ChEMBL161 human EAAT2 EC50 > 10 uM
notes: Rules out BBB exclusion of parent target threshold while exposing weak human EAAT2 transcriptional potency.

cohort_and_stratum: Human M1 Astro snRNA-seq (N=31) & NYGC Lumbar/Cervical/Motor bulk (N=223-238)
assay_and_contrast: Endogenous SLC1A2 (EAAT2) mRNA & CSF protein sALS vs Ctrl
effect_estimate: M1 Astro SLC1A2 7446 vs 7205 CPM (log2FC=+0.027); NYGC Lumbar beta=-0.055 (p=0.718); CSF TMT diff=-0.028
notes: Human ALS astrocytes do not exhibit transcriptional SLC1A2 mRNA loss for ceftriaxone to rescue.

cohort_and_stratum: 15-16 human sALS donor iPSC-MN lines
assay_and_contrast: 2.5 uM survival across excitability mechanisms vs paired DMSO
effect_estimate: Riluzole +3.959d (16/16, q=1.32e-10) vs Lamotrigine +0.899d (q=0.0695), Perampanel +0.113d, Mexiletine -0.288d, Flecainide -0.388d (p_W=0.0245)
notes: Only persistent INaP modulator Riluzole passes FDR (aside from supratherapeutic Memantine); class Ib/Ic Na+ blockers trend negative.

cohort_and_stratum: Human M1 snRNA-seq (N=25-30) & NYGC 4 CNS regions (N=206-257)
assay_and_contrast: Donor-level KCNQ2 & GRIN1 expression in ALS vs Control
effect_estimate: M1 L5 KCNQ2 log2FC=-0.443 (p=0.000462), GRIN1 log2FC=-0.737 (p=0.00167); NYGC Cervical KCNQ2 beta=-0.815 (p=2.30e-5)
notes: KCNQ3 & SCN8A unchanged in M1 L5 (p>0.33); Guo 2025 PMID:41174170 confirms TDP-43-driven KCNQ2 exon-5 skipping.

cohort_and_stratum: Living-patient 4-center CSF DIA proteomics (N=259)
assay_and_contrast: CSF synaptic pentraxin NPTX2 & AMPA subunit GRIA4 in ALS vs Control
effect_estimate: NPTX2 sALS vs Ctrl diff_log2=-0.202 (p=0.0398), ALS vs Ctrl -0.333 (p=0.000460); GRIA4 ALS vs Ctrl -0.284 (p=0.000239)
notes: Demonstrates living-patient excitatory synaptic loss/hypoexcitability transition in symptomatic ALS.

cohort_and_stratum: Human ALS Phase 2 RCTs of Mexiletine (N=60), Flecainide (FANS), & Talampanel (N=59)
assay_and_contrast: ALSFRS-R functional slope under blanket Na+ or AMPA blockade
effect_estimate: Mexiletine 300-900 mg/d reduced cramps without slowing ALSFRS-R; Flecainide 200 mg/d & Talampanel 150 mg/d failed primary slopes
notes: Blanket symptomatic Na+ and AMPA blockade repeatedly fail to modify human ALS progression.

cohort_and_stratum: 15 human sALS donor iPSC-MN lines
assay_and_contrast: 2.5 uM Memantine vs paired DMSO survival (days)
notes: Exact 2-sided Wilcoxon p=0.000122; tested at 2.5 uM (~4-10x human unbound CSF memantine).

cohort_and_stratum: UK MND-SMART Phase 3 adaptive platform trial Cycle 1 (N=554 total randomized)
assay_and_contrast: Memantine 20 mg/d vs contemporaneous placebo ALSFRS-R slope & survival
effect_estimate: Stopped at Stage 2 interim futility: monthly ALSFRS-R -0.650 vs -0.655 (adj diff +0.033/mo), no survival benefit
notes: Well-powered multicenter randomized Phase 3 futility stop in human MND/ALS.

cohort_and_stratum: US TAME Phase 2b (N=89, 40 mg/d x 36 wk) & MEDALS Phase 2/3 (N=63, 20 mg/d x 12 mo)
assay_and_contrast: ALSFRS-R linear mixed slope, blood pNfH/NfL, & behavioral endpoints
effect_estimate: No significant difference vs placebo in ALSFRS-R decline, blood neurofilaments, or survival across both RCTs
notes: Additional trials NCT00409721 (N=42) & NCT01020331 (N=20) also yielded no controlled functional benefit. [p_value reported as NS (non-significant) in primary clinical source]

cohort_and_stratum: Human memantine CSF/serum PK (5-30 mg/d) & NDA021487 (fup=0.55)
assay_and_contrast: Unbound human CSF concentration vs human NMDA receptor Ki/IC50
effect_estimate: Human CSF/serum ratio 0.52 -> ~0.25-0.6 uM CSF at 20-40 mg/d vs human NMDA Ki=0.54-1.0 uM (GRIN1/2A IC50=0.91 uM)
notes: Confirms physiological NMDA target engagement in human ALS CNS while showing Bye 2025 2.5 uM is 4-10x higher.

cohort_and_stratum: 15 human sALS donor iPSC-MN lines
assay_and_contrast: 2.5 uM Ropinirole vs paired DMSO survival (days)
effect_estimate: -0.688 d (12/15 negative, 1/15 tied at 0.0 d, 2/15 positive [80.0% worsened, 86.7% non-positive], rank #94/107, t=-3.597)
notes: Exact 2-sided Wilcoxon p=0.00525 (q=0.0312, 14 non-zero pairs); significant net motor-neuron survival harm across sALS donors.

cohort_and_stratum: ROPALS Phase 1/2a ALS patients on 16 mg/d ropinirole ER (N=13 CSF, N=18 plasma)
assay_and_contrast: MW-normalized CSF/plasma molar PK (MW 260.38) vs D2/D3 Ki & non-D2 potency
effect_estimate: Wk24 CSF 17,884 pg/mL = 68.68 nM (95% CI 54.48-86.59 nM); engages DRD2/3 (Ki 2.9-7.2 nM), 14.6-145.6x below 1-10 uM non-D2 rescue
notes: Corrects Morimoto Discussion unit typo ('~18 nmol/L' for 17.88 ng/mL); GI AEs in 76.9% vs 14.3% placebo cap dose.

cohort_and_stratum: NYGC Lumbar Spinal Cord donor-deduplicated RNA-seq (N=223)
assay_and_contrast: Human spinal DRD2/DRD3 expression & BA9 GC-adjusted signature
effect_estimate: Spinal DRD3 0.0% donors >=1 CPM; Lumbar DRD2 median 0.70 CPM (<1 CPM in 67.8% ALS)
notes: Replicated in NYGC Cervical (N=238: DRD3 0.0% >=1 CPM, DRD2 median 0.59 CPM); M1 L5 DRD2 median 2.83 CPM; BA9 signature collapsed after GC control.

cohort_and_stratum: ROPALS Ph1/2a double-blind RCT (N=20: 13 ropinirole vs 7 placebo)
assay_and_contrast: 24-wk blinded ALSFRS-R primary outcome
effect_estimate: ROPALS 24-wk DB ALSFRS-R diff +1.46 (95% CI -3.15 to 6.07, null)
notes: Corroborated by UK multicenter EXPERTS-ALS platform trial (ISRCTN15525855, 16 mg/d ER), which stopped the ropinirole arm Oct 2026 for futility (no blood NfL reduction). [p_value reported as NS (non-significant) in primary clinical source]

cohort_and_stratum: Human oral furosemide 40 mg PK (MW 330.74, 91-99% albumin bound) vs hNKCC1A/B IC50
assay_and_contrast: Unbound plasma & OAT3/MRP4-effluxed CNS exposure vs human NKCC1 potency
effect_estimate: fup=0.01-0.02 -> Cu,plasma ~0.05-0.14 uM; BBB/choroid efflux yields Cu,CNS <1-5 nM vs hNKCC1 IC50 ~18-23 uM
notes: Systemic loop diuresis/hypokalemia/dehydration ceiling prevents CNS target engagement; 0 ALS trials on CT.gov.

cohort_and_stratum: NYGC Cervical Spinal Cord donor-deduplicated RNA-seq (N=238: 197 ALS vs 41 Ctrl)
assay_and_contrast: RIN+GC-adjusted OLS expression of neuronal chloride extruder SLC12A5 (KCC2)
effect_estimate: NYGC Cervical SLC12A5 beta=-0.595 (unadj diff_log2=-0.658)
notes: Corroborated in DS005_BYE Table 4 sALS vs Control iPSC-MNs (log2FC=-0.391, p=0.000557, padj=0.0486); furosemide co-inhibits KCC2 and oral 40 mg reduces human spinal Renshaw inhibition (PMC4221825).

cohort_and_stratum: 15 human sALS donor iPSC-MN lines
assay_and_contrast: 2.5 uM Perampanel vs paired DMSO survival (days)
notes: Exact 2-sided Wilcoxon p=0.7354; complete lack of survival rescue in sALS iPSC-MNs.

cohort_and_stratum: Japanese multicenter Phase 2 RCT in sporadic ALS (placebo, 4 mg/d, 8 mg/d x 48 wk)
assay_and_contrast: Primary 48-wk ALSFRS-R change, bulbar subscore, SAEs, & completion
effect_estimate: 8 mg/d worsened ALSFRS-R decline vs placebo by -8.4 pts (bulbar-driven); SAEs higher (p=0.0483); completion 33% vs 82%
notes: 4 mg/d also showed no benefit; demonstrates dose-dependent functional and bulbar harm under chronic AMPA blockade.

cohort_and_stratum: Human ALS Single-Ascending-Dose TMS biomarker study NCT03793868 (N=22)
assay_and_contrast: Motor-cortex TMS motor threshold target engagement & human GRIA1 IC50
effect_estimate: Confirmed human ALS motor-cortex TMS threshold engagement (N=22) at human GRIA1 IC50=243-623 nM
notes: Additional US ALS trials NCT03377309 (N=6 halted due to adverse events) and NCT03020797 (N=12 terminated for low enrollment & early progression dropouts) failed tolerability; NDA202834 carries Boxed Warning for serious psychiatric reactions.
